about.title: About Vmito

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To simplify badminton session management and connect players with the best games in town.

hero.title: Badminton Made Simple

players.description: Focus on playing, not organizing. We handle the logistics so you can handle the shuttle.

fairPlay.description: Our automated rotation system ensures everyone gets equal court time.

review1.text: Vmito has completely changed how we organize our weekly games. No more spreadsheets!
review1.author: Minh, Host

review2.text: I love the fair play rotation system. It ensures everyone gets equal court time.
review2.author: Sarah, Player

q1.question: Is it free to use?
q1.answer: Yes, Vmito is free for players. Hosts have access to premium features for a small fee.

q2.question: How are skill levels determined?
q2.answer: We use a self-rating system combined with match history to ensure balanced games.

q3.question: Can I book courts through the app?
q3.answer: Currently, we focus on session management. Court booking features are coming soon.
